content:
alex: Heads up — seen persistent KV cache growth on long-context runs with our paged-attention path. Hard to repro on single-GPU, but mixed H100/MI250 jobs show ~12-18% VRAM creep over 30m.
priya: hmm, that sounds like the eviction order might be non-deterministic across buses. any traces?
sam: Also: did kernel selection fallback change recently? could affect timings/batching and thereby reuse patterns.
alex: attaching quick profiling dump from tonight (trimmed):
```
profiling-bot: kvcache_evict_seq: [GPU0: 0x1a,0x2b,0x3c,0x4d] -> time 120ms
profiling-bot: kvcache_evict_seq: [GPU1: 0x3c,0x1a,0x4d,0x2b] -> time 135ms
profiling-bot: kv_reuse_hits: GPU0=72% GPU1=64%
profiling-bot: page_table_frag: GPU0=0.12 GPU1=0.29
```
priya: thanks. ordering mismatch + fragmentation delta. that 0.29 PT frag is high. may cause ghost pages to linger.
matt: are we seeing any stale owner refs in the page metadata? earlier bug had ghost ptrs after cross-gpu migration.
ale x: typo — meant alex: no stale owner refs in the simple repro, but longer runs show `pt_owner` flips during concurrent evict which looks suspicious.
lee: quick repro command I ran: `RUN_MODE=mixed ./tools/longctx_kv_repro --model paged-attn --steps 12000 --batch 8 --route nvlink`
sam: on that run, can you dump `kvcache.meta` after 10k steps? need to check tombstone counts and whether entries are being reallocated out of order.
lee: posted JSON blob to GCS: gs://redwood-debug/kvcache/6177/debug_meta_10k.json
priya: idea — kernel selection changed to prefer larger tiling on H100 which shifts allocate/evict boundaries; combined with asymmetric PCIe/NVLink ordering we might be hitting a race in the shadowmap compaction.
matt: agree. also check batching heuristics: when batch size fluctuates, we run different kernel variants which change sequence of KV writes. different write order -> different eviction footprint.
alex: for next steps I propose: 1) lock kernel variant (force old tiling kernel) and rerun repro across mixed cluster; 2) enable verbose PT trace (only 1/10 runs) to capture owner flip; 3) try run with `KV_EVICT_STRICT_ORDER=1` flag to force centralized ordering and see if growth stops.
sam: add a perf counter: count of `evict_write_out_of_order` and `pt_tombstone_reuse` per GPU.
lee: running 1) & 3) now on staging (job id: kd-evict-test-009). will share traces asap.
profiling-bot: job kd-evict-test-009 started at 6177777788 on cluster mixed-h100-mi250.
priya: if strict ordering fixes it, we have a workaround but need to root cause: shadowmap compaction algorithm assumes commutative evict sequences across buses — apparently false.
matt: long term: add deterministic eviction sequence generator in runtime and a test harness that fuzzes bus ordering (nvlink/pcie interleave). also consider adding per-page epoch to detect reorder.
alex: agreed. keep logs short for now — will update with kd-evict-test-009 results. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
